posts.headline: Lahur Sheikh Jangi-aligned outlets push torture allegation by detained guard Hamarash against PUK security
posts.summary: Media outlets close to jailed Lahur Sheikh Jangi circulated allegations that detained guard Hamarash told the court at a recent hearing he had been severely tortured in PUK custody, including claims of physical violence and sexual abuse, with the Independent Human Rights Commission flagged as drawing attention to the case and KDP-aligned media also amplifying the claim as part of a possible coerced-confessions probe.

posts.headline: KIU's Bahaddin meets PUK's Bafel Talabani as Islamic Union turns down ministerial offers from both KDP and PUK to keep mediator role
posts.summary: Kurdistan Islamic Union leader Salahaddin Bahaddin met PUK's Bafel Talabani in Sulaimani, with both KDP and PUK having offered the KIU several high-level posts that the party is rejecting to preserve an independent mediator position, with the stated goal of throttling the media warfare between the two main parties while the cabinet-formation deadlock runs on.

posts.headline: IAEA confirms normal radiation levels and no injuries at Barakah NPP after drone strike, DG Grossi calls for maximum military restraint near nuclear sites
posts.summary: Bacharelhalabi reshared the IAEA statement that the UAE informed the agency radiation levels at Barakah remained normal and no injuries were reported after a morning drone strike hit an electrical generator outside the inner perimeter, with emergency diesel generators providing power to unit 3 and DG Rafael Grossi expressing grave concern and reiterating the call for maximum military restraint near any nuclear power plant.

posts.headline: Abu Dhabi authorities confirm drone-caused fire at Barakah NPP electrical generator outside inner perimeter, no radiological impact
posts.summary: Bacharelhalabi shared the Abu Dhabi authorities' first official statement that they had responded to a fire at an electrical generator outside the inner perimeter of the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant in the Al Dhafra Region caused by a drone strike, with no injuries reported and no impact on radiological safety levels per the Federal Authority for Nuclear Regulation.

posts.headline: US media report a possible imminent US strike on Iran as the war cycle re-escalates
posts.summary: American media outlets are reporting that the United States may strike Iran as the latest escalation cycle deepens, posted alongside the Barakah drone-strike news and Trump's clock-is-ticking warning. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Israeli Broadcasting Corporation quotes an official saying the US and Israel are raising readiness
posts.summary: Israeli public broadcasting cited an official saying that the United States and Israel are raising their military readiness level, in the immediate wake of the Barakah strike and the Trump warning to Tehran. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Trump warns Iran that time is running out and they must move quickly or nothing will remain of them
posts.summary: President Trump publicly warned that for Iran, time is running out and they must move quickly on a deal or nothing will remain of them, framing the next strike as a wide one. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Sistani office in Najaf confirms Monday May 18 as the first of Dhul Hijjah 1447, anchoring the Eid al-Adha calendar
posts.summary: The office of Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Sistani in Najaf confirmed that Monday May 18, 2026 marks the first of Dhul Hijjah 1447 AH, anchoring the Eid al-Adha calendar and the post-Eid window the Zaidi cabinet is sequencing the remaining nine portfolios against. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Axios reports Trump discussed the Iran file with European leaders ahead of the next escalation move
posts.summary: Axios reported that President Trump discussed the Iran file directly with European leaders as Washington signals the next strike could be very wide, part of the diplomatic preparation around the Qatar and Pakistan mediation track. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Araji meets Sudani and praises the latter's accomplishments while affirming Coordination Framework support for the Zaidi government
posts.summary: Qassim al-Araji, a regular mediator inside the Shia political stack, met former PM Sudani at his Baghdad residence and praised his accomplishments while reaffirming full Coordination Framework backing for the new Zaidi-led cabinet, in a move framed by the account as calming intra-Shia tensions after the Reconstruction bloc's portfolio-share grievance. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: Account flags an Electricity Ministry conflict-of-interest issue as a former-MP complaint against PM and Electricity Minister surfaces
posts.summary: The post argues the Electricity Ministry has outstanding obligations to one of the figures in the new cabinet and frames the arrangement as a conflict of interest, in parallel to a Shafaq News report of a former MP filing a formal conflict-of-interest complaint against PM Zaidi and the new Electricity Minister. Translated from Arabic.

posts.headline: IAEA tells the world that UAE confirms normal Barakah radiation levels and no injuries after the drone attack
posts.summary: The account translated the IAEA statement into Arabic, conveying that the UAE informed the agency that radiation levels at the Barakah Nuclear Power Plant remained within normal limits and no injuries were reported following the drone strike outside the plant's perimeter. Translated from Arabic.
